newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Stora's H1 profit seen 1.13 bln Skr.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Stora's H1 profit seen 1.13 bln Skr.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora was expected to post a 30 percent fall in six-month profit, after financial items, to 1.13 billion crowns, a Reuter survey of 14 analysts showed on Wednesday.
The forecasts ranged from one billion crowns to 1.26 billion.
For the full year Stora was expected to show a profit of 2.49 billion crowns, up from 2.35 billion crowns in 1996. In 1998, analysts expected Stora to post a profit of 4.68 billion crowns.
Stora will release its report for the first six months of the year on August 5.
(million Skr) Average Range No of analysts

Analysts polled were from: Aros, Carnegie, CI Nordic Securities, Enskilda, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Morgan Grenfell, Myrberg & Wiklund, Nordiska, Norske Bank, Paribas, Salomon Brothers and Swedbank.
